LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AlcyoniteSolar.description: Uses alcyonite solar cells to extract electricity from the sun. Inactive.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AlcyoniteSolar.label: alcyonite solar generator
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AlcyoniteSolar_Advanced.descrip: Uses alcyonite solar cells to extract electricity from the sun. Inactive.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AlcyoniteSolar_Advanced.label: advanced alcyonite solar generator
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AlienComplianceCenter.descripti: An experimental device that emmanates strange waves making everyone love the truly alien weather. Inactive.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AlienComplianceCenter.label: ocular compliance center
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AncientBloodRainVent.descriptio: A massive duct that drops endlessly into the ground. It will regularly vent huge red clouds of a vaporized blood-like substance that will coalesce into a disgusting blood rain. Permanently inactive.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AncientBloodRainVent.label: ancient blood rain vent
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AncientBone.description: This fosilized bone might have belonged to an exceptionally large Gallatross. Note: if you have the Rim of Madness - Bones mod installed, you can deconstruct these into useable bones.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AncientBone.label: ancient bone
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AncientBrokenBone.description: This fosilized bone might have belonged to an exceptionally large Gallatross. Note: if you have the Rim of Madness - Bones mod installed, you can deconstruct these into useable bones.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AncientBrokenBone.label: ancient shattered bone
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AncientDeathPallVent.descriptio: A massive duct that drops endlessly into the ground. It will regularly vent clouds of microscopic self-powered archites that affect corpses reanimating them to create a twisted imitation of life. Permanently inactive.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AncientDeathPallVent.label: ancient death pall vent
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AncientFreezingVent.description: A massive duct that drops endlessly into the ground. It will regularly vent freezing cold air from an underground megastructure, dramatically lowering the temperature of the surrounding area. Permanently inactive.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AncientFreezingVent.label: ancient freezing vent
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AncientGallatrossSkull.descript: This skull belonged to an exceptionally huge Gallatross. Look at the size of this thing! Note: if you have the Rim of Madness - Bones mod installed, you can deconstruct these into useable bones.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AncientGallatrossSkull.label: ancient gallatross skull
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AncientGreyPallVent.description: A massive duct that drops endlessly into the ground. It will regularly vent large amounts of sickly looking smoke that will plunge the area into a preternatural darkness. Permanently inactive.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AncientGreyPallVent.label: ancient gray pall vent
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AncientVerticalBone.description: These fosilized bones might have belonged to an exceptionally large Gallatross. Note: if you have the Rim of Madness - Bones mod installed, you can deconstruct these into useable bones.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_AncientVerticalBone.label: ancient bones
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_BumbledroneHive.description: A huge mound of hardened organic matter that communicates with an extensive underground hive. This one was built out of papier mache.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_BumbledroneHive.label: bumbledrone hive
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_DerelictArchonexusCore.descript: The ruined central core of an archonexus. Its broad surfaces are dusty and covered with vegetation. It seems to be long inert.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_DerelictArchonexusCore.label: derelict archonexus core
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_DerelictArchotechTower.descript: A moderately-sized archotech tower rising from the ground. It seems to be long inert.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_DerelictArchotechTower.label: derelict archotech tower
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_DerelictBeachUmbrella.descripti: A beach umbrella so broken that it won't even keep the sun out.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_DerelictBeachUmbrella.label: derelict beach umbrella
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_DerelictMajorArchotechStructure: A large archotech structure. The dull green surface is ruiend and covered in vegetation. It seems to be long inert.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_DerelictPoolLadder.description: This pool ladder has seen better days.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_DerelictPoolLadder.label: derelict pool ladder
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_DerelictRecliner.description: A recliner used for relaxation. Rotten and dirty to the point of uselessness.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_DerelictRecliner.label: derelict recliner
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_DerelictSwimmingPool.descriptio: This was once a relaxing swimming pool, but it is now a fetid, stagnant pool of water.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_DerelictSwimmingPool.label: derelict swimming pool
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_DessertTree.description: An easy answer to the question: "what would you create if you were an insane plant geneticist?". This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_DessertTree.label: dessert tree
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_DirtyBeachBall.description: A half-deflated beach ball that has seen better days.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_DirtyBeachBall.label: dirty beach ball
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_DirtyPoolFloat.description: A deflated and dirty pool float.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_DirtyPoolFloat.label: dirty pool float
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_FleshTree.description: A grotesque growth of pulsing, veiny tissue stretched over a warped wooden frame. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_FleshTree.label: flesh tree
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_GallatrossBones.description: This ribcage once belonged to a living Gallatross of truly exceptional size. Note: if you have the Rim of Madness - Bones mod installed, you can deconstruct these into useable bones.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_GallatrossBones.label: gallatross bones
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_GoldenCubeTree.description: These rare trees grow giant, shimmering golden cubes in place of fruit. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_GoldenCubeTree.label: golden cube tree
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_HugeGallatrossSkeleton.descript: These fosilized bones might have belonged to an exceptionally large Gallatross. Note: if you have the Rim of Madness - Bones mod installed, you can deconstruct these into useable bones.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_HugeGallatrossSkeleton.label: huge gallatross skeleton
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_LuminescentTree.description: A tree-like giant bramble that supports a huge globe of glowing sap that casts a soft, colorful light in the dark. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_LuminescentTree.label: luminescent tree
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_MagmaThermalPlant.description: Produces electricity from hyperheated geothermal steam geysers in a magma rich zone. Inactive.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_MagmaThermalPlant.label: magma-thermal generator
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_Mech_RuinedActivator.descriptio: A ruined mech proximity activator. Perhaps a few components can be scavenged from this one.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_Mech_RuinedActivator.label: ruined mech proximity activator
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_Mech_RuinedAssembler.descriptio: A ruined mech assembler. Thankfully it has been inactive for a while.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_Mech_RuinedAssembler.label: ruined mech assembler
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_Mech_RuinedCapsule.description: A ruined mech capsule. Thankfully it has been empty for a while.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_Mech_RuinedCapsule.label: ruined mech capsule
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_Mech_RuinedCell.description: A ruined mech power cell. Perhaps a few components can be scavenged from this one.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_Mech_RuinedCell.label: ruined mech power cell
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_Mech_RuinedLargeGunPlatform.des: A ruined mech large turret base. Whatever this base held, it's long gone.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_Mech_RuinedMortar_Full.descript: A ruined mech auto-mortar. Completely broken. No useful components can be scavenged from this old mortar.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_Mech_RuinedMortar_Full.label: ruined mech mortar
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_Mech_RuinedMortar_Single.label: ruined mech mortar gun
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_Mech_RuinedShield.description: A spent mech shield generator. Still faintly humming.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_Mech_RuinedShield.label: ruined mech shield
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_Mech_RuinedTurret_Full.descript: A ruined mech turret. Completely broken. No useful components can be scavenged from this old turret.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_Mech_RuinedTurret_Full.label: ruined mech turret
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_Mech_RuinedTurret_Single.descri: A ruined mech turret base. Completely broken.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_Mech_RuinedTurret_Single.label: ruined mech turret base
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_MechanoidReceiver.description: A wide band receiver designed to intercept lingering mechanoid signal patterns from the environment. Completely inactive.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_MechanoidReceiver.label: mechanoid resonance receiver
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_MycoticCollector.description: Collects edible airborne micro-fungi present in this map and extracts them into processed fungi that can be used as a food ingredient. Inactive.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_MycoticCollector.label: mycotic collector
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_OcularGasSpewer.description: This device needs a small amount of electricity to condense atmospheric gases and spew a large cloud of ocular gas. Inactive.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_OcularGasSpewer.label: ocular gas spewer
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_ShackledGamma.description: A containment vat designed to preserve and regulate the life of a Gamma plant beyond its natural span. This gamma seems to be a plastic plant.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_ShackledGamma.label: shackled gamma
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_SlimeCompressor.description: A bulky, churning machine that grinds down organic slime and compresses it under immense pressure, slowly transforming the ooze into dense, usable sandstone. Inactive.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_SlimeCompressor.label: slime compressor
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_TarPump.description: Extracts tar from a natural tar hole and transforms the tar into chemfuel. Inactive.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_TarPump.label: tar pump
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_TechnoTree.description: A bizarre fusion of bark and circuitry, this half-synthetic tree hums with low energy pulses. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AB_TechnoTree.label: techno tree
LanguageData.VFEPD_Aaklac.description: A rare, huge flower which can be found in the deepest jungles. Its quite striking colour and nice smell makes it popular in gardening, if it can be extracted from the deep jungle, of course. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_Aaklac.label: aaklac
LanguageData.VFEPD_AgaricusDomeCap.description: Everything about this fungus screams "I'm toxic, stay away from me". This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AgaricusDomeCap.label: agaricus domecap
LanguageData.VFEPD_AgariluxPrime.description: An unbelievably large exemplar of Agarilux. This myconic colony has adapted perfectly to its environment. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AgariluxPrime.label: Agarilux Prime
LanguageData.VFEPD_AlienGrass.description: This grass is completely alien, probably not even 100% carbon based. Not very edible for terrestrial creatures. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AlienGrass.label: ocular grass
LanguageData.VFEPD_AlienTree.description: This tree is completely alien, probably not even 100% carbon based, and it seems to be struggling to grow from exposure to a terrestrial environment. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AlienTree.label: ocular tree
LanguageData.VFEPD_AlienTree_Polluted.description: This ocular tree has been affected by pollution and mutated in strange ways. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_AlienTree_Polluted.label: mutated ocular tree
LanguageData.VFEPD_ArbuscularMycorrhiza.description: A mycorrhiza is a symbiotic association between a fungus and a plant. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_ArbuscularMycorrhiza.label: arbuscular mycorrhiza
LanguageData.VFEPD_BloodBouquet.description: A spiny plant with some kind of fruit hanging from its top. The fruit seems to be as hard as the trunk itself, and equally covered in spines. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_BloodBouquet.label: blood bouquet
LanguageData.VFEPD_BrownBarrelCactus.description: The brown barrel cactus, Ferocactus Brunetus, is an extremophile plant that thrives in low-water and poor sunlight conditions. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_BrownBarrelCactus.label: brown barrel cactus
LanguageData.VFEPD_CrystalFlower.description: A tall, translucent flower that seems to be partially inorganic. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_CrystalFlower.label: crystal flower
LanguageData.VFEPD_CrystalHorn.description: This strange flower seems to be only partially organic. Part of its structure is clearly crystalline, and it appears to be unaffected, or even bolstered, by the extremely cold climate. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_CrystalHorn.label: crystal horn
LanguageData.VFEPD_DeadBowerTree.description: Despite its common name, the dead bower tree is not truly dead, just exceptionally adapted to survival in arid weather. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_DeadBowerTree.label: dead bower tree
LanguageData.VFEPD_DribblingCap.description: A huge pink mushroom, constantly dribbling a pungent, resin-like substance. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_DribblingCap.label: dribbling cap
LanguageData.VFEPD_DriedRavenNettle.description: Tangled, thorny, woody shoots covered with leaves. Raven nettle grows in clusters, and slows down anyone moving over it. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_DriedRavenNettle.label: dried raven nettle
LanguageData.VFEPD_EuphorbiaDesiccata.description: A plant of the euphorbia genus, commonly called spurges. This plant is a variety of the Euphorbia Rimworldia plant that has adapted to polluted environments. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_EuphorbiaDesiccata.label: euphorbia desiccata
LanguageData.VFEPD_EuphorbiaRimworldia.description: A plant of the euphorbia genus, commonly called spurges. This plant has adapted to arid climates and stores a lot of water inside their spine-covered leaves. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_EuphorbiaRimworldia.label: euphorbia rimworldia
LanguageData.VFEPD_ExoticFlowers.description: A bunch of colourful flowers. These are fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_ExoticFlowers.label: exotic flowers
LanguageData.VFEPD_EyeGrass.label: flowering ocular grass
LanguageData.VFEPD_FanPalm.description: This exuberant palm grows in areas with a rich soil surrounding the tar pits. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_FanPalm.label: fan palm
LanguageData.VFEPD_FirevineTree.description: Firevine trees are pyrophitic plants that are able to survive wildfires due to a clever layer of thermal insulation provided by their fire retardant bark. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_FirevineTree.label: firevine tree
LanguageData.VFEPD_FlashFrozenTree.description: This tree, which probably started growing in a rare period of summer heat, has been frozen in place by the extreme temperatures, its leaves crystallized by the toxic propane compounds. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_FlashFrozenTree.label: flash frozen tree
LanguageData.VFEPD_FrostLeaf.description: These translucent plants seem to be able to grow almost anywhere, even in some snow covered areas. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_FrostLeaf.label: frost leaf
LanguageData.VFEPD_GargantuanLithops.description: Lithops is a genus of succulent plants often known as pebble plants or living stones, due to their stone-like appearance that allows them to avoid being eaten by blending in with surrounding rocks. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_GargantuanLithops.label: gargantuan lithops
LanguageData.VFEPD_GiantAgariTox.description: A giant mushroom that has adapted to growing in extremely polluted environments. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_GiantAgariTox.label: agaritox
LanguageData.VFEPD_GiantAgarilux.description: A colossal purple mushroom. Its size and glowing protrusions make this fungus beautiful to look at. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_GiantAgarilux.label: giant agarilux
LanguageData.VFEPD_GiantFlower.description: Giant flowers genetically modified by a long-forgotten genetics company using the genome of a hibiscus plant. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_GiantFlower.label: giant mutant hibiscus
LanguageData.VFEPD_GiantGamma.description: Like many other flora from the Forsakens native planet, this huge globular plant is bioluminescent. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_GiantGamma.label: giant gamma
LanguageData.VFEPD_GiantSeptimum.description: This Septimum plant has grown to an enormous size, with a flowering top as large as a person. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_GiantSeptimum.label: giant septimum
LanguageData.VFEPD_GiantStikehr.description: A giant alien mushroom that glows in the strange darkening mist. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_GiantStikehr.label: giant stikehr
LanguageData.VFEPD_GiantSunflower.description: Giant flowers genetically modified by a long-forgotten genetics company using the genome of the common sunflower plant. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_GiantSunflower.label: giant sunflower.
LanguageData.VFEPD_GiantToxicFlower.description: A continously blooming giant flower with a dangerous, bright pink colour. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_GiantToxicFlower.label: giant toxic flower
LanguageData.VFEPD_GiantTulip.description: Giant flowers genetically modified by a long-forgotten genetics company using the genome of a tulip plant. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_GiantTulip.label: giant tulips
LanguageData.VFEPD_GlobularPlant.description: A sickly pink orb supported by a network of gnarled branches. A reddish sap constantly drips from its wood, and seems to keep insects at bay. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_GlobularPlant.label: globular aberration
LanguageData.VFEPD_GlobularPlant_Polluted.description: This globular aberration has been affected by pollution and mutated in strange ways. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_GlobularPlant_Polluted.label: polluted globular aberration
LanguageData.VFEPD_GlowingGrass.description: Wild grass. Grows anywhere there is a little light and minimally fertile ground. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_GlowingGrass.label: glowing grass
LanguageData.VFEPD_Gomphoeria.description: An unusually tall plant with bright, pink nodules. Its nodules are slightly toxic for humans, and it produces a strange, rotten fruit smell, so it is considered absolutely inedible. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_Gomphoeria.label: gomphoeria
LanguageData.VFEPD_GreenRockFern.description: A wild tall fern. Slows down anyone moving over it. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_GreenRockFern.label: green rock fern
LanguageData.VFEPD_HalfAlienTree.description: A strange infection seems to be transforming this regular oak into an ocular tree. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_HalfAlienTree.label: half transformed ocular tree
LanguageData.VFEPD_HardyGrass.description: Wild grass. Grows anywhere there is a little light and minimally fertile ground. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_HardyGrass.label: hardy grass
LanguageData.VFEPD_Iashiphus.description: This vivid green plant seem to be related to cacti. Though it's fleshy bark is not edible, it produces flowers than can be consumed by humans. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_Iashiphus.label: iashiphus
LanguageData.VFEPD_JungleTree.description: This jungle tree is not of terrestrial origins, originating from the deepest crevices of an alien jungle. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_JungleTree.label: deep jungle tree
LanguageData.VFEPD_JungleTree_Polluted.description: This jungle polux tree has adapted so perfectly to polluted soil and airborne toxins that it doesn't even need to remove pollution from its environment. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_JungleTree_Polluted.label: deep jungle polux
LanguageData.VFEPD_KeeningCordax.description: The keening cordax is a carnivore plant so called for the high-pitched sound that it makes during the day. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_KeeningCordax.label: keening cordax
LanguageData.VFEPD_LandCoral.description: A very strange purple coloured fungus that resembles a coral. Grows only in polluted soil. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_LandCoral.label: amethyst land coral fungus
LanguageData.VFEPD_LargeSlimyTree.description: This tree doesn't seem to be entirely solid. Upon further examination, it isn't an independent entity, its roots fusing seamlessly with the hardened gelatinous ground. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_LargeSlimyTree.label: large slimy tree
LanguageData.VFEPD_LilacBeacon.description: The lilac beacon is a tall mushroom with a bright purple cap. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_LilacBeacon.label: lilac beacon
LanguageData.VFEPD_MangrovePalm.description: A palm tree adapted to the mangrove conditions. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_MangrovePalm.label: mangrove palm
LanguageData.VFEPD_MangroveTree.description: A tree that grows in saline or brackish water. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_MangroveTree.label: mangrove tree
LanguageData.VFEPD_ParasiticMangrove.description: A weird, colourful plant adapted to extract nutrients from mangrove trees. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_ParasiticMangrove.label: parasitic mangrove
LanguageData.VFEPD_PollutedStikehr.description: A giant alien mushroom that glows in the strange darkening mist. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_PollutedStikehr.label: polluted stikehr
LanguageData.VFEPD_RavenNettle.description: Tangled, thorny, woody shoots covered with leaves. Raven nettle grows in clusters, and slows down anyone moving over it. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_RavenNettle.label: raven nettle
LanguageData.VFEPD_RecurvedStropharia.description: A big greyish mushroom. Its size and glowing protrusions make this fungus beautiful to look at. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_RecurvedStropharia.label: recurved stropharia
LanguageData.VFEPD_RedBugloss.description: One of the weirdest plants from Earth, genetically modified to thrive in wet, warm environments. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_RedBugloss.label: red bugloss
LanguageData.VFEPD_RedLeaves.description: This grass is completely alien, probably not even 100% carbon based. Not very edible for terrestrial creatures. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_RedLeaves.label: ocular plant
LanguageData.VFEPD_RedPlantsTall.description: This grass is completely alien, probably not even 100% carbon based. Not very edible for terrestrial creatures. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_RedPlantsTall.label: ocular plant
LanguageData.VFEPD_RimeNodules.description: A very strange plant, partly inorganic, that seems to extract propane from the surrounding landscape and store it as an energy source in rime-bound chemical sacs. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_RimeNodules.label: rime nodules
LanguageData.VFEPD_SessileMechanoid.description: This thing was once a tree. Mechanoids repurposed its cells into a half-tree, half-mechanoid abomination, serving an unknown purpose. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_SessileMechanoid.label: sessile mechanoid tree
LanguageData.VFEPD_Slimecasia.description: Although at first sight this seems to be an independent plant, its roots are intricately interconnected with the rest of the gelatinous superorganism. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_Slimecasia.label: slimecasia
LanguageData.VFEPD_SlimyFern.description: Although at first sight this seems to be an independent plant, its roots are intricately interconnected with the rest of the gelatinous superorganism. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_SlimyFern.label: slimy fern
LanguageData.VFEPD_SlimyPholiota.description: A blueish-pink mushroom, secreting a slimy substance that attracts insects. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_SlimyPholiota.label: slimy pholiota
LanguageData.VFEPD_SlimyTree.description: This tree doesn't seem to be entirely solid. Upon further examination, it isn't an independent entity, its roots fusing seamlessly with the hardened gelatinous ground. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_SlimyTree.label: slimy tree
LanguageData.VFEPD_SugarFamewort.description: The sugar famewort grows in areas with a high concentration of pollinating insects. It generates a sweet nectar that attracts these insects, and they disperse its pollen when they feed on it. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_SugarFamewort.label: sugar famewort
LanguageData.VFEPD_TallSlimyGrass.description: Wild tall grass. Slows down anyone moving over it. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_TallSlimyGrass.label: tall slimy grass
LanguageData.VFEPD_TangleTea.description: This strange plant seems to be of alien origins. It doesn't seem to be fit for human consumption. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_TangleTea.label: tangle tea
LanguageData.VFEPD_TentacularPlant.description: This plant is completely alien. The blue nodules at the end of each branch / tentacle produce an eerie rattling sound from time to time. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_TentacularPlant.label: tentacular aberration
LanguageData.VFEPD_TinkleGrass.description: Wild grass. Grows anywhere there is a little light and minimally fertile ground. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_TinkleGrass.label: tinkle grass
LanguageData.VFEPD_ToxiBulb.description: This slimy bulb seems to be feeding on the polluted terrain like a parasite. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_ToxiBulb.label: toxibulb
LanguageData.VFEPD_ToxiGrass.description: Wild grass. Grows anywhere there is a little light and minimally fertile ground. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_ToxiGrass.label: toxi grass
LanguageData.VFEPD_ToxicGamma.description: A huge bioluminescent globular plant. Can be used as a natural sunlamp to grow regular plants, though the toxic environment it grows at might not be the best for cultivation. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_ToxicGamma.label: toxic gamma
LanguageData.VFEPD_WeepingToxberry.description: A short toxin-adapted shrub with berries so unbelievably toxic that no animal would ever dare consume them. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_WeepingToxberry.label: weeping toxberry
LanguageData.VFEPD_WildRadagast.description: This twisting alien plant grows small glowing berries. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_WildRadagast.label: wild radagast
LanguageData.VFEPD_WitchesOyster.description: A small, ramified fungal colony with a pungent aroma. This one is fake.
LanguageData.VFEPD_WitchesOyster.label: witches' oyster
